notes: Improved: Simulator, Judgement looks better: the HELL / HEAVEN banner sits on a dark band in bright white letters with a glow, so it can always be read; the veil at the swap is a bloom that stays bright in the middle instead of a flat wall; in the omen a column of light comes down on the Angel and fire climbs up the Devil; in the realm both fighters have a living aura (embers off the Devil, feathers of light off the Angel) that flares in their Last Stand; Simulator, stronger abilities: Rift blinks hit and its ultimate has five cuts ending in a tear; Automaton fires faster, launches a missile salvo and its Overclock is a double shockwave; Chrono's field hurts and its rewind leaves an echo that explodes; Crimson hits harder the lower its health, heals more and its Blood Moon drains three more times; Prism fires five beams and spins faster; Bomber lays six mines that hit harder; Visitor fires two probes; Swarm's storm and the Jester's jackpot hit harder. Fixed: Simulator, Coliseum on a wide (PC) frame: the HELL / HEAVEN banner was turned sideways with the arena; it is now drawn upright across the screen
